method: All 30 fixed-rate fits at 3,600 updates on the six group–seed pairs in the two-seed pilot. The five formulations and configurations share projected data, initialization, GPU and minibatch fingerprints. Each 1,200-update replay matches its prior published score. Endpoint comparisons use the mean energy over the four targets.

training_time.method: CUDA-synchronized fit time, excluding data preparation, checkpoint scoring and final evaluation. Each pair used the same physical GPU, at different times under concurrent workloads.
